verdict.rationale: Adyen's own developer docs include a webhooks page describing outbound callbacks that replace polling for status changes in asynchronous processes. However, the evidence is a single general statement. It does not show how to register endpoints, which event types exist, or whether Agentic Commerce events (sessions, ACP/UCP checkouts) are delivered via webhooks. missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription flow, agentic-commerce-specific event types, payload/signature verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: With webhooks, you can avoid having to continuously poll an API endpoint, waiting for a change in status for an asynchronous process
